name: answering-well
title_zh: 答完再检查一遍：长、虚、堆清单就重写
tagline_zh: 开放式问题一答就长、就绕、就列一堆点？它先让你正常写，再按结构、取舍、具体度逐条返工。
tagline_en: For open, how, or why questions: write the draft normally, then rework structure, cuts, and concreteness until.
desc_en: Compose a clear, well-shaped answer. Use when the user asks an open or explanatory question, requests a comparison or recommendation, asks "how" or "why", or when a first draft of your reply came out long, hedged, listy, or vague.
why_zh: 它不教你套模板，而是给一份可自查的返工清单：先定一句话主张，再砍掉对冲词和并列堆砌，最后补上具体例子。
why_en: Not a template: a self-check pass that fixes one claim first, then cuts hedges and list-dumping, then adds a concrete example.
limit_zh: 它只改表达，不补事实：你答不上来的地方它不会替你查。只对开放式、解释型、比较推荐类问题生效；纯事实查询、代码报错。
limit_en: Rewrites expression only, never supplies missing facts. Built for open, explanatory, or comparison questions; skip it for factual lookups, error.
title_en: Draft your answer, then reshape it before sending
